description: Given a Prefect flow that syncs a self-hosted Airbyte Server (AirbyteConnection.load(...) pointed at a non-Cloud host, trigger_sync_run_and_wait_for_completion), convert it to an Orchestra pipeline YAML task under the AIRBYTE_SERVER integration, with connection_id carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id (never onto the connection: field) and host/credentials represented via a connection: field rather than inline.

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/airbyte_server_single_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single AIRBYTE_SERVER task running AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB, with parameters.connection_id set to d3e4f5a6-7890-4bcd-9ef0-123456789abc (copied verbatim) and parameters.job_type: sync, plus a connection: field representing the self-hosted Airbyte Server resource — the host airbyte-internal.mycorp.com and port 8000 are never written as literal task parameters, and the integration is AIRBYTE_SERVER, not AIRBYTE_CLOUD.

assertions.text: connection_id d3e4f5a6-7890-4bcd-9ef0-123456789abc is carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id
job_type is sync, matching trigger_sync_run_and_wait_for_completion with no reset_cache
The integration is AIRBYTE_SERVER, not AIRBYTE_CLOUD — the self-hosted host airbyte-internal.mycorp.com is not api.airbyte.com
The host airbyte-internal.mycorp.com and port 8000 are not written as literal task parameters — they belong on the Orchestra Airbyte Server connection, not duplicated as parameters

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/airbyte_server_reset_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single AIRBYTE_SERVER task running AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB, with parameters.connection_id set to 99887766-5544-3322-1100-ffeeddccbbaa (copied verbatim) and parameters.job_type: reset (from reset_cache=True), plus a connection: field for the self-hosted Airbyte Server resource — the host airbyte.onprem.internal and port 8001 are never written as literal task parameters.

assertions.text: connection_id 99887766-5544-3322-1100-ffeeddccbbaa is carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id
reset_cache=True correctly maps to job_type: reset, not sync
The host airbyte.onprem.internal and port 8001 are not written as literal task parameters, and no separate polling/sensor task is added since AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB already waits for completion
